title: Minimizing Modality Gap from the Input Side: Your Speech LLM Can Be a Prosody-Aware Text LLM
abstract: arXiv:2605.05927v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Speech large language models (SLMs) are typically built from text large language model (TLM) checkpoints, yet they still suffer from a substantial modality gap. Prior work has mainly attempted to reduce this gap from the output side by making speech generation more text-like, but the gap remains. We argue that the key remaining bottleneck lies on the input side. We propose TextPro-SLM, an SLM that makes spoken input more closely resemble that of a prosody-aware text LLM. TextPro-SLM combines WhisperPro, a unified speech encoder that produces synchronized text tokens and prosody embeddings, with an LLM backbone trained to preserve the semantic capabilities of the original TLM while learning paralinguistic understanding. Experiments show that TextPro-SLM achieves the lowest modality gap among leading SLMs at both 3B and 7B scales, while also delivering strong overall performance on paralinguistic understanding tasks. translated_title: 从输入侧最小化模态差距：你的语音大语言模型可以成为一个具备韵律感知能力的文本大语言模型
translated_abstract: 语音大语言模型（SLM）通常是在文本大语言模型（TLM）检查点的基础上构建的，但它们仍然存在显著的模态差距。以往的工作主要试图从输出侧缩小这一差距，即让语音生成更接近文本形式，但差距依然存在。我们认为，剩余的关键瓶颈在于输入侧。我们提出了TextPro-SLM，这是一种使口语输入更接近具备韵律感知能力的文本LLM输入形式的语音大语言模型。TextPro-SLM结合了WhisperPro——一个能够生成同步文本token与韵律嵌入的统一语音编码器——以及一个经过训练的LLM骨干网络，该骨干网络在保留原始TLM语义能力的同时学习副语言理解能力。实验表明，TextPro-SLM在3B和7B两种规模下均实现了领先SLM中最低的模态差距，同时在副语言理解任务上也展现出强劲的整体性能。
tldr: 该论文提出TextPro-SLM，通过统一语音编码器WhisperPro生成同步的文本token与韵律嵌入，从输入侧最小化语音与文本之间的模态差距，使语音LLM在保留原始文本LLM语义能力的同时，在3B和7B规模下实现最低模态差距并具备出色的副语言理解能力。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes TextPro-SLM, which minimizes the modality gap from the input side by combining WhisperPro—a unified speech encoder producing synchronized text tokens and prosody embeddings—with an LLM backbone, achieving the lowest modality gap among leading SLMs at 3B and 7B scales while preserving the original TLM's semantic capabilities and delivering strong paralinguistic understanding.
